# ChainAware Examples

Python examples for the ChainAware Behavioral Prediction MCP — fraud detection, AML scoring,
rug pull detection, wallet analytics, token analysis, and 30+ more use cases, via Claude agents
or direct MCP calls.

Links: https://chainaware.ai · https://x.com/ChainAware/ · https://www.linkedin.com/company/chainaware
       https://chainaware.ai/blog · https://chainaware.ai/learn
MCP repo: https://github.com/ChainAware/behavioral-prediction-mcp

Accuracy: 98% Fraud Detection · 90.1% Rug Pull Detection — backtesting verified

Recognition: CB Insights Fraud Prevention Market Map for the AI Era (2026) · BNB Chain AI Landscape
(2025) · BNB Chain Kickstart Marketing Tools (2025) · $250k Google Cloud Grant (2025) ·
AWS Fintech Accelerator (2024) · Safary Club Web3 Growth Landscape (2024)

---

## MCP Server

URL: https://prediction.mcp.chainaware.ai/sse
Transport: SSE (persistent connection — NOT streamable HTTP)
Auth: API key passed as query param (?apiKey=...) and X-API-Key header
Networks: ETH · BNB · POLYGON · BASE · TRON · TON · HAQQ · SOLANA

### MCP Tools

predictive_fraud           Fraud probability (0.00–1.00) + AML forensics + sanctions
predictive_behaviour       Behavioral profile: experience, segments, reputation, rank
predictive_rug_pull        Rug pull risk on a smart contract or LP
predictive_fraud_batch     Async batch fraud scoring (returns job_id)
predictive_behaviour_batch Async batch behaviour scoring (returns job_id)
check_job_status           Poll async job status
get_job_results            Retrieve async job results
credit_score               Crypto credit score (1–9) combining fraud + social graph
token_rank_list            Top tokens ranked by holder community strength (by network + category)
token_rank_single          Community rank + top holder profiles for one token
run_token_audit            Deep contract audit — 0–100 risk score (returns job_id)
get_token_audit_result     Retrieve token audit result
agents_trust_score_list    ERC-8004 agent registry — discover and rank registered AI agents
agents_trust_score_single  Full trust profile for a specific agent by agent_id + chain_id

## Repository Structure

python/chainaware_sse.py          Shared helper — imported by ALL example scripts
python/agents/                    Agent-based examples (34 scripts)
python/MCP/                       Direct MCP examples (3 scripts)
python/scripts/agent_tools.py     MCP server registry + frontmatter tool parser
python/scripts/run_all_examples.py  Run all examples sequentially with summary table
python/requirements.txt           anthropic>=0.40.0, mcp>=1.0.0
.claude/agents/                   34 agent definitions from behavioral-prediction-mcp repo
.env.example                      Copy to .env and set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + CHAINAWARE_API_KEY

---

## Shared Helper: python/chainaware_sse.py

Unlike the streamable-HTTP helpers in similar projects, this module opens ONE persistent SSE
connection at import time and reuses it across every call. This avoids repeated
connect/disconnect cycles and supports local MCP servers (http://localhost:5000/sse) that
Anthropic's managed MCP beta cannot reach.

Connection: opened in a background daemon thread via asyncio; blocks up to 30s on first run()
call while the session initialises.

Public functions:

run(prompt, frontmatter="", system=None, model="claude-haiku-4-5-20251001", max_tokens=4096)
  Agentic loop with tool access filtered to those listed in the agent frontmatter.
  Used by python/agents/ scripts. Timeout: 300s.

run_direct(prompt, system=None, model="claude-haiku-4-5-20251001", max_tokens=4096)
  Like run() but with no tool filtering — all MCP tools available.
  Used by python/MCP/ scripts. Timeout: 300s.

api_key() -> str
  Returns CHAINAWARE_API_KEY. Inject into prompts for tools that require it inline.

is_contract(address, chain) -> bool   [async]
  Detects whether an address is a smart contract or EOA via Etherscan V2 API.
  Used by agent_screener.py and compliance_screener.py for automatic type detection.
  Requires ETHERSCAN_API_KEY. Supported chains: ETH, BNB, BASE, POLYGON, ARB, HAQQ.

---

## Two Example Patterns

### Agent-based (python/agents/)

The .md agent definition from .claude/agents/ is loaded as the system prompt. Tool
selection, output format, and thresholds are defined in the .md, not in code.

Pattern:
1. Load .claude/agents/<name>.md
2. Split on "---" to extract frontmatter (YAML between first two ---) and body (system prompt)
3. Parse `model:` from frontmatter; default to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
4. Pass minimal user message (address/contract/network — no API key in message)
5. Call chainaware.run(user_message, frontmatter=frontmatter, system=system_prompt, model=model)

Standard load_agent() function used by all agent scripts:

  def load_agent(path: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
      with open(path) as f:
          content = f.read()
      parts = content.split("---", 2)
      frontmatter = parts[1] if len(parts) >= 3 else ""
      body = parts[2].strip() if len(parts) >= 3 else content.strip()
      m = re.search(r"^model:\s*(.+)$", frontmatter, re.MULTILINE)
      model = m.group(1).strip() if m else "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001"
      return model, body, frontmatter

### Direct MCP (python/MCP/)

A plain user prompt with all MCP tools available. The API key is injected inline via
chainaware.api_key(). Used by fraud_detector.py, rug_pull_checker.py, token_ranker.py.

---

## CSV Helper Patterns

### CSV loader (used by batch scripts)

  def load_addresses_from_csv(csv_path: str) -> list[str]:
      # auto-detects column named address/wallet/Address/Wallet; falls back to first column

### Single-or-CSV auto-detection (used by many scripts)

  target = sys.argv[1]
  if os.path.isfile(target):
      addresses = load_addresses_from_csv(target)
  else:
      addresses = [target]

---

## Agent Definitions (.claude/agents/)

34 agent definitions — must not be hand-edited; come from the upstream repo.

Refresh from GitHub:
  gh api repos/ChainAware/behavioral-prediction-mcp/contents/.claude/agents | python3 -c "
  import json, sys, base64, subprocess
  for f in json.load(sys.stdin):
      data = json.loads(subprocess.run(['gh', 'api', f['url']], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout)
      open(f'.claude/agents/{f[\"name\"]}', 'w').write(base64.b64decode(data['content']).decode())
      print('Updated', f['name'])
  "

## Running Examples

Run all commands from the project root.

  # hardcoded single wallet
  python python/agents/fraud_detector.py
  python python/agents/wallet_auditor.py
  python python/agents/rug_pull_checker.py
  python python/agents/aml_scorer.py
  python python/agents/agent_screener.py
  python python/agents/agent_trust_screener.py                        # top registered agents
  python python/agents/agent_trust_screener.py 1 56                   # agent #1 on BNB
  python python/agents/credit_scorer.py
  python python/agents/defi_advisor.py

  # single wallet (pass on CLI)
  python python/agents/onboarding_router.py 0xABC... ETH
  python python/agents/platform_greeter.py 0xABC... ETH Aave
  python python/agents/governance_screener.py 0xABC... ETH token-weighted
  python python/agents/lead_scorer.py 0xABC... ETH "DeFi lending" acquisition
  python python/agents/lending_risk_assessor.py 0xABC... ETH standard '$10,000' '6%'
  python python/agents/marketing_director.py 0xABC... ETH "Platform description"
  python python/agents/reputation_scorer.py 0xABC... ETH
  python python/agents/rwa_investor_screener.py 0xABC... ETH moderate
  python python/agents/trust_scorer.py 0xABC... ETH
  python python/agents/upsell_advisor.py 0xABC... ETH "basic DEX swap" revenue
  python python/agents/wallet_marketer.py 0xABC... ETH
  python python/agents/wallet_ranker.py 0xABC... ETH
  python python/agents/whale_detector.py 0xABC... ETH

  # CSV batch
  python python/agents/airdrop_screener.py wallets.csv ETH
  python python/agents/cohort_analyzer.py wallets.csv ETH retention
  python python/agents/ltv_estimator.py wallets.csv ETH
  python python/agents/ltv_estimator.py wallets.csv ETH 0.30          # lending (30% share)
  python python/agents/ltv_estimator.py wallets.csv ETH 0.10 0.003   # DEX (10% share, 0.3% fee)
  python python/agents/sybil_detector.py voters.csv ETH "Proposal #42"
  python python/agents/gamefi_screener.py players.csv ETH "MyGame" 500
  python python/agents/portfolio_risk_advisor.py portfolio.csv
  python python/agents/portfolio_risk_advisor.py portfolio.csv conservative
  python python/agents/wallet_marketer_batch.py wallets.csv ETH results.csv
  python python/agents/wallet_marketer_batch.py wallets.csv ETH results.csv Aave

  # unique input
  python python/agents/token_analyzer.py 0xCONTRACT... ETH
  python python/agents/token_ranker_single.py 0xCONTRACT... ETH
  python python/agents/token_audit_analyst.py                         # demo: PEPE on ETH
  python python/agents/token_audit_analyst.py 0xCONTRACT... eth
  python python/agents/token_launch_auditor.py 0xCONTRACT... 0xDEPLOYER... ETH
  python python/agents/token_ranker_list.py ETH "DeFi Token" 10
  python python/agents/transaction_monitor.py 0xSENDER... 0xRECEIVER... ETH

  # direct MCP
  python python/MCP/fraud_detector.py
  python python/MCP/rug_pull_checker.py
  python python/MCP/token_ranker.py

  # run all examples
  python python/scripts/run_all_examples.py

## Setup

  pip install -r python/requirements.txt
  cp .env.example .env
  # edit .env: set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CHAINAWARE_API_KEY, and optionally ETHERSCAN_API_KEY

Environment variables:
  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY      Required — your Anthropic API key
  CHAINAWARE_API_KEY     Required — your ChainAware API key (chainaware.ai/pricing)
  ETHERSCAN_API_KEY      Optional — for automatic contract/EOA detection in agent_screener.py
                         and compliance_screener.py. Supported chains: ETH, BNB, BASE, POLYGON,
                         ARB, HAQQ.
  CHAINAWARE_MCP_URL     Optional — override to http://localhost:5000/sse for local dev

Load .env before running:
  export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs)

---

## Claude Code Setup

Register the MCP server in Claude Code:

  claude mcp add --transport sse chainaware-behavioral-prediction \
    https://prediction.mcp.chainaware.ai/sse \
    --header "X-API-Key: $CHAINAWARE_API_KEY"

Copy agent definitions into your project:

  cp .claude/agents/chainaware-*.md your-project/.claude/agents/

---

## Rate Limiting

The MCP server enforces rate limits server-side. Mitigations in place:

- run_all_examples.py: 3s delay between scripts; 30s after any timeout to let the SSE
  connection clear before the next script.
- wallet_marketer_batch.py: 3s between per-wallet chainaware.run() calls (it's the only
  batch script that makes one API call per wallet rather than one call for the whole list).
- wallets.csv: trimmed to 3 wallets for the demo suite.

The other CSV batch scripts (airdrop_screener, cohort_analyzer, ltv_estimator, etc.) send
all wallets in a single chainaware.run() call — rate limiting is handled server-side.

## Model Override Notes

All agent MD files specify claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Three scripts also explicitly override
the model after load_agent() to keep demo runs within the 120s timeout:
- portfolio_risk_advisor.py  — Sonnet + 2 tools per token is too slow for demo
- marketing_director.py      — Sonnet + multiple subagent orchestration is too slow
- wallet_marketer_batch.py   — Sonnet + per-wallet loop would exceed 120s

---

## Tool Filtering: python/scripts/agent_tools.py

MCP_SERVER_REGISTRY maps "chainaware-behavioral-prediction" to the SSE endpoint + API key.
parse_tool_names(frontmatter) extracts the comma-separated tools: list from frontmatter.
MCP_TOOL_RE = re.compile(r"^mcp__([^_].*?)__([^_].*)$") matches MCP tool IDs.
build_mcp_and_tools(frontmatter) builds (mcp_servers, mcp_toolsets) for Anthropic beta MCP.
run() uses parse_tool_names to build allowed_mcp (set) and native_tools list.
